# Theory: Sync Policy is When the Loop May Write

Manual sync is a human-gated apply. Auto-sync is the loop applying whenever Git moves. Self-heal reapplies when the cluster drifts. Prune deletes objects gone from Git.

## Invariants

1. Every field on spec.syncPolicy is a permission the controller has.
2. Server-side apply vs client-side merge is a conflict-management choice.
3. History limits bound how much old sync state you keep.

```text
Git move → (auto-sync?) → apply → (prune?) → health
```

## What can break

- Auto-prune on a shared namespace you do not fully own.

## How to read this chapter

First app, policy, prune, retries/options, namespace/labels, recap.
